reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in our DM: send the truck to **Bay 46**. That's the dock Ilse said in an earlier private message they use for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups (under the name Nettle).

My answer came from my saved notes, since our current DM only has today's question. I didn't check the team channels for a newer dock. I also asked Ilse to tell me if Thursday's pickup goes somewhere else, so I can update the note.

My notes also list Marcus's and Dana's Thornbury docks. Those came from their own private messages, so I left them out of the reply.
